p: Rye Lane is Peckham's main drag, a busy, colourful street packed with food shops, market stalls, hair salons and cafés, and MERKUR at 67-69 is right in amongst it. Peckham Rye station, with trains and the Overground, is just along the street. Strictly 18+.

Peckham has become one of South London's best spots for food and drink, with plenty of places along Rye Lane and the side streets. In summer, the rooftop bar on top of the multi-storey car park has cracking views across the London skyline. At the far end of Rye Lane, Peckham Rye Park and Common offer gardens, a café and space to stretch out.
